## ZnO Γ 点的红外偏振与简并子空间: ## Infrared polarization and degenerate subspaces at Γ in ZnO
在[声子模式计算器](../#compute/phonon-modes?pres: Open the ZnO infrared polarization exercise in the [phonon mode calculator](../#compute/phonon-modes?preset=zno-ir). Predict which optical cluster couples to an electric field along the crystal's c axis. Then verify the inputs and compare fields along c and in the basal plane.
对于质量加权并已归一化的模式向量，逐原子以质量平方根去权重，再用 Born 有效: Convert each atom's components of a normalized mass-weighted mode vector to Cartesian displacements by dividing by the square root of its mass, then map them to a mode dipole derivative with the Born effective-charge tensor. For a closed degenerate cluster, sum the squared magnitudes of all these dipole derivatives along the same unit polarization. The result is in e²/u.
这里 P 是质量加权模式子空间的正交投影。两列正交基同时转动，P 保持不变。固定: Here P is the orthogonal projector onto the mass-weighted mode subspace. Rotating the two orthonormal basis vectors leaves P invariant. At fixed x polarization, rotating the E₁ basis by π/5 changes the individual weights from about (0.711466, 0.003568) to (0.514809, 0.200225), while their sum remains about 0.715034.
比较 A₁ 在沿 c 偏振下的投影 0.706253，与 E₁ 在基面内偏振下的: Compare the A₁ projection of 0.706253 for a field along c with the E₁ projection of 0.715034 in the basal plane. Use the two closed E₂ optical clusters as controls. Their projections are zero within numerical tolerance. The polarization and the degenerate basis are independent choices. Only the polarization changes the projection of a fixed cluster onto the electric field.
该例沿用同一版 Phonopy 官方 ZnO 数据、配对原胞和原始 Born 张: The exercise uses the pinned Phonopy ZnO data, matching primitive cell and original Born tensors, with non-analytic correction disabled for the Γ-point eigenvectors. It preserves the residual charge sum of the source tensors and compares optical clusters. The output is a squared mode dipole derivative. An experimental lineshape or a directional LO–TO splitting requires additional dynamical or spectroscopic inputs.
